entities.summary: Samanid, a notable figure in the history of Uzbekistan, associated with Turkic Period and Early Islam (819–999). Preceded by Samanid Bukhara Golden Age and Qutayba ibn Muslim conquers Bukhara and Samarkand for the Umayyad Caliphate. Their legacy influenced Karakhanid Rule and Turkification.
